verdict.rationale: Rive documents a built-in AI agent that takes natural-language prompts to generate scripts, layouts, data models, and animations, plus an MCP integration letting external AI/coding agents create and edit Rive files, state machines, and shaders. This directly satisfies natural-language operation of the product for AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI agent's reliability and no community corroboration of actual natural-language workflows in practice.
